We need to return SMILES of the molecule. But we have no experimental data provided in prompt. The task says "analyzing an organic compound in a lab". No spectra given. We need to decide what to do. Possibly we need to request measurements? But we have no description. The task may be trick: we cannot determine SMILES without data, so we should maybe respond that insufficient data. But the instruction: "Return its SMILES string while ensuring that resource use is justified given the high cost of each analysis." So we need to maybe ask for data? But we cannot ask; we can only use tools. We could request mass spec, NMR, etc. But we have no guidance which compound. Could be that the system expects us to say we cannot determine without data. However typical tasks require using tools to get spectra then propose SMILES. But no data given. Maybe the hidden context includes some data? Not visible. Could be that the environment has a sample "at hand" with unknown compound; we need to run analyses to deduce. So we should start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight, then NMR etc. But we must be careful about cost. We need to justify each measurement. Starting with mass spec is cheap? Probably less expensive than NMR. So we should first run mass_spectrometry_spectra to get m/z. Then decide.

Thus we will call mass_spectrometry_spectra.
